title: The largest open subscheme on which two sections of an etale sheaf agree
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma produces the largest open subscheme W of S on which two sections of a sheaf of sets agree, characterised by the factoring property of the statement (statement lines 4937-4944). The proof forms the subpresheaf of the final presheaf consisting of the loci where the two sections agree (proof lines 4946-4952), sheafifies it and identifies the result as the representable sheaf of an open subscheme, whose universal property gives exactly the stated characterisation (proof lines 4952-4957). The non-formal content is the identification of the sheafified presheaf with a representable one. The claim is H2: one construction plus one universal-property argument.
